meta.name: prisma-compute
meta.description: Prisma Compute deployment and hosting guide. Use whenever the user mentions Prisma Compute, `prisma.compute.ts`, `defineComputeConfig`, deploying or hosting a Prisma app, `@prisma/cli app deploy`, `compute:deploy`, `create-prisma --deploy`, `PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN`, Compute auth/workspaces, apps/deployments/build logs/domains, localhost vs `0.0.0.0`, deploy port binding, or framework deploy readiness for Hono, Elysia, Next.js, TanStack Start, Astro, Nuxt, Svelte, Nest, Turborepo, or custom/prebuilt artifacts.

copy.tagline: 部署 Prisma 后端服务到托管平台,理顺端口、域名与构建日志。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把 Prisma 应用发布到托管平台,想搞定端口、域名和构建日志。
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Prisma apps to managed hosting: handle domains, ports, and build logs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you deploy Prisma apps and need help setting up ports, domains, and build logs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Prisma 官方指南帮你把应用部署到 Prisma Compute:检查项目配置与部署命令,处理构建、认证、环境变量、日志等,并判断框架是否支持部署。
howto.when: 当你提到 Prisma Compute、prisma.compute.ts、应用部署/托管、PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN、构建日志、部署端口绑定等话题,或要求排查部署失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Hono 应用部署到 Prisma Compute。
say.note: Claude 会检查配置并执行部署流程。

say.text: 看看这份 prisma.compute.ts 的配置对不对。
say.note: Claude 会按项目实际配置核对并指出问题。

say.text: 部署失败了,帮我查构建日志。
say.note: Claude 会用 build logs 命令定位失败原因。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude guides deployment and hosting of apps on Prisma Compute: it inspects project config and deploy commands, handles builds, auth, env vars, logs, and checks framework deploy readiness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Prisma Compute, prisma.compute.ts, app deploy/hosting, PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN, build logs, deploy port binding, or ask to debug a failed deployment.

say_en.text: Deploy this Hono app to Prisma Compute.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect config and run deployment.
Claude validates it against project setup.

say_en.text: Deploy failed; check the build logs.
say_en.note: Claude uses build logs to find the cause.
